description: VTID-05276 (plan kiro-autonomy-fallback §4.3), VTID-05408 (kiro-lane-admin §4): protected gate files. A change to one never merges on a reviewer-agent accept alone; it needs the owner's instruction naming the plan plus a reviewer-agent accept on the current head (Claude Code is retired). Globs use scripts/collab/queue.mjs globToRegex semantics. Owned by scripts/collab/queue.mjs (compiled-in copy for single-file runs); the Project Manager mirrors it in governance.ts.
